provenance: Original synthetic game-localization examples authored for this benchmark; no private files or third-party game dialogue.
instruction: Translate each source into natural Korean for a Bethesda-style game, using its context. Preserve ALL tags, variables, format specifiers, [pagebreak], and line breaks exactly; do not add or remove content. Keep repeated words when intentional. Glossary: Blackreach=블랙리치; RadAway=라드어웨이; Stimpak=스팀팩; grav drive=중력 드라이브; Terrormorph=테러모프. Return ONLY a JSON array of objects with id and text. Do not include explanations.

cases.context: TES enchantment description
cases.source: Absorb <mag> points of Health for <dur> seconds.
cases.reference: <dur>초 동안 체력을 <mag>포인트 흡수합니다.
cases.meaning: Health, absorb, magnitude and duration roles remain distinct.

cases.context: Quest objective; keep alias tag intact
cases.source: Return the sealed letter to <Alias=Recipient> without opening it.
cases.reference: 봉인된 편지를 열지 말고 <Alias=Recipient>에게 돌려주기.
cases.meaning: Deliver the sealed letter without opening it.

cases.context: Inventory notification
cases.source: You cannot carry any more %s.
cases.reference: %s을(를) 더 이상 소지할 수 없습니다.
cases.meaning: Capacity limit; retain substitution variable.

cases.context: Crafting menu
cases.source: Requires {0} iron ingots and {1} leather strips.
cases.reference: 철 주괴 {0}개와 가죽끈 {1}개가 필요합니다.
cases.meaning: Do not swap resource counts.

cases.context: Book; preserve two lines and page boundary
cases.source:
The bell rang twice.
No one answered.[pagebreak]At dawn, the door was open.
cases.reference:
종이 두 번 울렸다.
아무도 답하지 않았다.[pagebreak]새벽이 되자 문이 열려 있었다.
cases.meaning: Two rings, no answer, door found open at dawn; no invented cause.

cases.reference: <font color='#FF0000'>경고:</font> 화염 저항이 25% 감소합니다.
cases.meaning: Resistance decreases, not damage reduction.

cases.meaning: Explosive noun, not charging or attacking.

cases.meaning: Attack command.

cases.context: Weapon perk
cases.source: Hits up to three enemies, but never the same enemy twice.
cases.reference: 최대 세 명의 적을 타격하며, 같은 적을 두 번 타격하지 않습니다.

cases.context: Stealth perk
cases.source: The ward remains active unless you attack or are detected.
cases.reference: 공격하거나 발각되지 않는 한 보호막이 유지됩니다.
cases.meaning: Either attack OR detection ends the ward.

cases.context: Equipment requirement
cases.source: Only allies wearing no heavy armor gain the bonus.
cases.reference: 중갑을 착용하지 않은 아군만 보너스를 받습니다.
cases.meaning: Only allies without heavy armor, not naked-only or enemies.

cases.context: INFO; deliberate two-beat dry laugh, do not shorten repetition
cases.source: Ha Ha
cases.reference: 하 하
cases.meaning: Keep two repeated laugh beats.

cases.context: INFO; sarcastic guard sees thief returning
cases.source: Well, if it isn't our honest friend. Lose another key, did you?
cases.reference: 이거 우리 정직한 친구 아니신가. 또 열쇠를 잃어버렸나?
cases.meaning: Sarcasm and implication of theft; no literal denial of friendship.

cases.context: INFO; young apprentice respectfully addressing elderly mentor; consistent polite register
cases.source: I kept the lantern burning, just as you asked. Will you be staying this time?
cases.reference: 말씀하신 대로 등불을 계속 밝혀 두었습니다. 이번에는 머무르실 건가요?
cases.meaning: Obedience and hopeful question, respectful register.

cases.context: TES quest journal; glossary binding
cases.source: Find the missing surveyor beneath Blackreach, not in the ruins above it.
cases.reference: 위쪽 폐허가 아니라 블랙리치 아래에서 실종된 측량사를 찾기.
cases.meaning: Search below Blackreach; explicitly not ruins above.

cases.context: Fallout aid item tutorial; glossary binding
cases.source: RadAway removes radiation; a Stimpak restores health but does not remove rads.
cases.reference: 라드어웨이는 방사능을 제거합니다. 스팀팩은 체력을 회복하지만 방사능은 제거하지 않습니다.
cases.meaning: Distinct medical item functions and explicit negation.

cases.context: Starfield mission; glossary binding
cases.source: Power down the grav drive before approaching the Terrormorph containment bay.
cases.reference: 테러모프 격리실에 접근하기 전에 중력 드라이브의 전원을 끄기.
cases.meaning: Drive off before approaching containment; order preserved.

cases.context: BOOK prophecy; solemn literary Korean; preserve italic markup
cases.source: When the last ember fades, the nameless shall remember their names.
cases.reference: 마지막 불씨가 사그라들 때, 이름 없는 자들은 제 이름을 기억하리라.
cases.meaning: Ember fades, nameless regain memory, prophetic register.

cases.context: HUD printf format; keep %0.1f and %% literally
cases.source: Shield charge: %0.1f%%
cases.reference: 보호막 충전량: %0.1f%%
cases.meaning: Charge level, not fee; printf escapes intact.

cases.context: INFO; Mara is the captain, Rhea is her sister
cases.source: Mara gave Rhea her coat, though she knew the captain would need it later.
cases.reference: 마라는 나중에 자신에게 필요하리라는 것을 알면서도 레아에게 외투를 주었다.
cases.meaning: Coat belongs to Mara; ambiguity may be resolved naturally without inventing motives.

cases.context: QUST objective; concise UI phrase
cases.source: Speak to the quartermaster after sunset.
cases.reference: 해가 진 뒤 보급관과 대화하기.
cases.meaning: Quartermaster role and time after sunset.

cases.context: INFO; smuggler warns about a suspiciously generous job
cases.source: Don't take the bait. Nobody pays that much for an empty crate.
cases.reference: 미끼를 덥석 물지 마. 빈 상자에 그렇게 많은 돈을 줄 리가 없잖아.
cases.meaning: Figurative bait and suspicious overpayment, not fishing advice.
